message.content:
Based on my search, here is information about PreLicenseTraining login:

## Login Portals

**Student Login:**
- Main student login page: https://prelicensetraining.com/login
- This is for students who have purchased courses and need to access their training materials

**Mentor/Recruiter/Company Login:**
- Main mentor portal: https://prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
- Alternative mentor portals for specific partners:
  - Infinity Schools: https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
  - PSI Online: https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login

## Login Instructions

To log in to your PreLicenseTraining.com account:
1. Go to the appropriate login page (student or mentor)
2. Enter your login name and password
3. **Tip:** Your login name may be your email address unless you specified otherwise during registration

## Related Pages

- **Registration:** https://prelicensetraining.com/register (for new accounts)
- **Forgot Password:** Available through the mentor portals (e.g., https://psionline.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/forgotPassword)
- **California Mentor Registration:** https://prelicensetraining.com/ca/mentor/register (note: registrations require admin approval before you can access student data)

## About PreLicenseTraining

PreLicenseTraining.com provides online insurance pre-licensing education including streaming video instruction, online textbooks, practice exams with rationale, and a virtual practice testing center called StudyHall. They offer training for insurance licensing across multiple states.
